title: Tech Note: Import and Export Data From Related Tables

historical_commentary.text: Importing and exporting data from related tables remains a common requirement, though modern 4D provides much more sophisticated data exchange capabilities through ORDA, JSON/XML support, and built-in import/export enhancements. The workarounds described here reflect the limitations of 4D v6's built-in import/export menus.
related_updates: Modern 4D provides ORDA-based data access that simplifies related data export
JSON and XML import/export capabilities have been added to the platform
The built-in import/export functionality has been enhanced in later versions
